blocks.text: b) Instrumental without с is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. The word in the instrumental case will correspond to English "by means of…", "by the use of…": *Он открывает дверь ключом. Я пишу карандашом.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.
